subject.title: feat(memorySearch): Support multimodal embedding with gemini-embedding-2-preview

question: Should OpenClaw expand multimodal memory beyond the shipped opt-in image/audio file path into PDF/video files and remembered session attachments, and what consent, retention, deletion, provider-upload, and reindexing contract should gate it?
rationale: The missing behavior is technically feasible, but it changes what user media is uploaded to remote embedding providers and retained in searchable memory, so automation should not choose the product/security boundary.

options.title: Design Gated Media Memory First
options.body: Define supported modalities, explicit opt-in consent, retention/deletion behavior, provider limits, result presentation, and reindex behavior before implementation.

options.title: Keep Core To Shipped Subset
options.body: Leave core at Gemini image/audio file indexing and close or defer attachment/PDF/video memory until a stronger maintainer-sponsored direction appears.

options.title: Expand ExtraPaths Only
options.body: Allow a narrower follow-up for PDF/video files under configured memory paths while explicitly excluding remembered chat-attachment retention for now.

recommendation.title: Design Gated Media Memory First
recommendation.body: Define supported modalities, explicit opt-in consent, retention/deletion behavior, provider limits, result presentation, and reindex behavior before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice is closest to the shipped multimodal memory boundary introduced in PR https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/43460.
